book.name: MARCOS
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U KUXH Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Marcos tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Ni toksal ok u Jesús vatz u Pilato

As kuꞌsaj chittuꞌ, as ikꞌul veꞌt tibꞌ viyol unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh, tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa bꞌaal tenameꞌ, tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ chusel tibꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tzaqꞌiteꞌ, as tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa bꞌanol isuuchil unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As iqitz veꞌt chajnaj u Jesús. As bꞌex toksa veꞌt ok chajnaj Aak vatz u Pilato.
As ech tal veꞌt u Pilato ileꞌ: —¿Ma axh u tijlenaal unqꞌa tiaal Israel?— tiꞌk naj. —An chiteꞌ uveꞌ naaleꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh, as nimal ipaav Aak nikat icheesa chajnaj vatz u Pilato.
As ech tal veꞌt u Pilato ileꞌ te u Jesús unpajte: —¿Yeꞌ kuxh natiineꞌ? As tul nimal chit apaav ni tal chajnaj,— tiꞌk naj.
As kꞌuxh ech alpeꞌ te Aak, as mitaꞌn tal Aak umaj yol. As sotz veꞌt ikꞌuꞌl u Pilato stiꞌ.
Ni talpu veꞌt ikam u Jesús
As tu u nimla qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ pascua, as nik ichajpu u Pilato umaꞌl u preexhu, abꞌil uvaꞌ nikat tal unqꞌa tenameꞌ ichajpuleꞌ.
As atik ok umaꞌl u naj preexhuil uvaꞌ Barrabás. As txeyik naj tukꞌ kaꞌt imool, tan maꞌtik iyatzꞌon chajnaj tiꞌ ibꞌanat chꞌaꞌo tiꞌ u ijlenaaleꞌ.
As ul tal veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ te u Pilato uvaꞌ la ichajpu naj umaj u preexhueꞌ tu u nimla qꞌiieꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ nik ibꞌan tu jun yaabꞌ.
Ech tal veꞌt u Pilato ileꞌ: —¿Ma la esaꞌ uvaꞌ la unchajpu u najeꞌ uvaꞌ ni toksa tibꞌ setijlenaalil?— tiꞌk naj,
tan atik veꞌt skꞌuꞌl u Pilato uvaꞌ taꞌn kuxh chꞌoꞌnchil aama nikat toksakat unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh u Jesús tiqꞌabꞌ naj.
As unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa bꞌaal tenameꞌ, as toksa veꞌt chajnaj tiviꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ aꞌ u Barrabás la chajpuli.
As ech tal veꞌt u Pilato ileꞌ: —¿As kam nesaꞌ qꞌi uvaꞌ la unbꞌan tiꞌ vetijlenaaleꞌ uveꞌ netaleꞌ?— tiꞌk naj.
As taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ tuul iviꞌ. Ech tal ileꞌ: —¡Yatzꞌpoj naj vatz u kuruseꞌ!— tiꞌk unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
—¿As kam ipaav u najeꞌ qꞌi kat ibꞌana?— tiꞌk u Pilato. As aal chit taqꞌ jeꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ tuul iviꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt ileꞌ: —¡Yatzꞌpoj naj vatz u kuruseꞌ!— tiꞌk unqꞌa tenameꞌ.

As ichajpu veꞌt el tzan naj u Barrabás. As tal veꞌt naj iqꞌospu u Jesús taꞌn tzꞌuꞌm. As toksa veꞌt naj Aak tiqꞌabꞌ unqꞌa soleꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ la bꞌen yatzꞌpoj Aak vatz u kuruseꞌ. Tan aꞌ nital u Pilato uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn ikaa naj vatz u tenameꞌ.
As teqꞌo veꞌt ok unqꞌa soleꞌ u Jesús vatz iqꞌanal vikabꞌal u bꞌanol ivatz u ijlenaaleꞌ. As imol veꞌt unqꞌa soleꞌ unqꞌa imooleꞌ skajayil.
As toksa veꞌt unqꞌa soleꞌ umaꞌl u muraꞌt oksaꞌm tiꞌ u Jesús. As taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ chajnaj umaꞌl u koroona chꞌiꞌx tiꞌ iviꞌ Aak uvaꞌ paatxꞌumalike.
As ech tal chajnaj ileꞌ te Aak: —¡Keche, pap, axh tijlenaal unqꞌa tiaal Israel!— tiꞌk chajnaj tiꞌ teesal iqꞌii Aak.
As ivekꞌ chajnaj umaꞌl u aa tiꞌ iviꞌ Aak. As itzubꞌa veꞌt chajnaj Aak. As qaaebꞌ veꞌt chajnaj vatz Aak tiꞌ itzeꞌlel Aak.

As tul maꞌtik teesat chajnaj iqꞌii Aak, as teesa veꞌt el chajnaj u muraꞌt oksaꞌmeꞌ tiꞌ Aak. As toksa veꞌt chajnaj u toksaꞌm Aakeꞌ unpajte. As teqꞌo veꞌt el chajnaj Aak tiꞌ iyatzꞌpu veꞌt Aak vatz u kuruseꞌ.
Niyatzꞌpu veꞌt u Jesús vatz u kurus
As tul bꞌex paloj umaꞌl u aa Cirene uvaꞌ aalik itzaa tu vitz, as itxey veꞌt unqꞌa soleꞌ naj tiꞌ uvaꞌ la tija naj u kuruseꞌ. As Simón ibꞌii u najeꞌ. As naj ibꞌaal u Alejandro tukꞌ u Rufo.
As teqꞌo veꞌt unqꞌa soleꞌ u Jesús tu u atinbꞌal uvaꞌ Gólgota ibꞌii. (As aꞌ isuuchil u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ Gólgota: Tatinbꞌal Bꞌajil Kꞌoꞌn.)
As taqꞌ veꞌt chajnaj unbꞌiil u taꞌl uuva te Aak uvaꞌ yuel tibꞌ tukꞌ kꞌayla tzꞌakabꞌal uvaꞌ mirra ibꞌii. As jit isaꞌ Aak tukꞌataꞌ.

As tul maꞌt taqꞌat veꞌt jeꞌ unqꞌa soleꞌ u Jesús vatz u kuruseꞌ, as ijatx veꞌt chajnaj u toksaꞌm Aakeꞌ svatzaj. As itxꞌak veꞌt tibꞌ chajnaj tiꞌ u toksaꞌm Aakeꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ abꞌiste u najeꞌ la eqꞌon u toksaꞌm Aakeꞌ.
As bꞌeluval oora qꞌalaꞌm tul uvaꞌ taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ unqꞌa soleꞌ u Jesús vatz u kuruseꞌ.
As atik veꞌt jeꞌ umaꞌl u aqꞌen tiviꞌ u kuruseꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamalikkat uvaꞌ kam stiꞌ la kamkat Aak. As ech nik tal u tzꞌibꞌ ileꞌ: Aꞌ U TIJLENAAL UNQꞌA TIAAL ISRAEL, tiꞌk u tzꞌibꞌeꞌ.
As antik kaꞌvaꞌt unqꞌa elqꞌom taqꞌ jeꞌ chajnaj vatz kaꞌvaꞌt unqꞌa kuruseꞌ. Umaꞌl naj jeꞌ tisebꞌal u Jesús; as umaꞌt naj timax Aak.
As aꞌeꞌ kat ibꞌana uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: As kat oksal veꞌt xoꞌl tachul unqꞌa paasan tziꞌeꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: As tul uvaꞌ nik ipal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, as nik iyiku iviꞌ tul nikat iyoqꞌon tiꞌ u Jesús. As ech nik tal ileꞌ te Aak: —Nikat aaleꞌ uvaꞌ la eꞌpisa u tostiixheꞌ. As titoxvu qꞌii la alak unpajte, uvaꞌ naaleꞌ.
As qꞌalpu eebꞌ vatz u kamchileꞌ scheel. As kuꞌen chꞌuꞌl vatz u kuruseꞌ,— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.

As echat chit nik ibꞌan unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh, tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ chusel tibꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tzaqꞌiteꞌ, tan ech nik tal chajnaj ileꞌ svatzaj tul nikat iyoqꞌon tiꞌ u Jesús: —Kꞌuxh kat iqꞌalpu naj unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ vatz unqꞌa chꞌoꞌmeꞌ, as yeꞌ nitxꞌol veꞌt naj iqꞌalput tibꞌ vatz u kuruseꞌ.

Asoj naj u Cristo, u tijlenaal u kutenameꞌ uvaꞌ tiaal Israel, as kuꞌoj chꞌuꞌl naj vatz u kuruseꞌ. As tul la qil ikuꞌ chꞌuꞌl naj, as aꞌn la kunima veꞌt naj,— tiꞌk chajnaj. As echat nik ibꞌan unqꞌa najeꞌ uveꞌ atik jeꞌ vatz unqꞌa kuruseꞌ kꞌatz u Jesús, tan nik teesa chajnaj iqꞌii Aak.
As tul chaqꞌaan veꞌt qꞌii, as tokin veꞌt ivatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ. As techanal oon veꞌt oxvaꞌl oora kuꞌqꞌii, as aꞌn ilon veꞌt u qꞌiieꞌ unpajte.

As tul oon veꞌt oxvaꞌl oora kuꞌqꞌii, as taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ u Jesús tuul iviꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —¿Eloi, Eloi, lama sabactani?— tiꞌk Aak. Aꞌ isuuchil u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ: «¡Kubꞌaal Tiixh, Kubꞌaal Tiixh! ¿Kam qꞌi uveꞌ nu kuxh aaqꞌ kan in sunjunal?» tiꞌk Aak.
As kaꞌl unqꞌa uxhchil uvaꞌ atik tzitziꞌ, as tul tabꞌi u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tal u Jesús, as ech tal veꞌt ileꞌ svatzaj: —¡Etabꞌitaj! Tan nimolo veꞌt naj u Elías,— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.

As oora chit bꞌex umaꞌl u naj tiꞌ takꞌsat umaꞌl u patxkin kꞌoo taꞌn kꞌayla taꞌl uuva. As ikꞌaloꞌk naj tiꞌ ijuꞌ umaꞌl u aa. As taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ naj te u Jesús. As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —¡Qeꞌna! ¡Qil kuxhtuꞌ! Pet tuk qileꞌ ma tuk uloj u Elías tiꞌ teqꞌol kuꞌ tzan naj vatz u kuruseꞌ,— tiꞌk naj.
As aal chit taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ u Jesús tuul iviꞌ tiꞌ isikꞌineꞌ. As kam veꞌt Aak.
As qꞌixmu veꞌt u nimla ixbꞌuꞌjeꞌ uveꞌ nik jatxon tuul u tostiixheꞌ. As kaꞌvaꞌl kuꞌ u ixbꞌuꞌjeꞌ stuul, tan kat qꞌixmik kuꞌ tzan tiviꞌ as kat ul xeꞌ toj.

As viqꞌesal unqꞌa soleꞌ uvaꞌ txaklik kꞌatz u kuruseꞌ, as tul tabꞌi naj isikꞌin u Jesús as til naj uvaꞌ kam ibꞌan Aak tul kat kam Aak, as ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —An chiteꞌ vil. IKꞌaol Tiixheꞌ vil u najeꞌ,— tiꞌk naj.

As atik kaꞌl unqꞌa ixoj tzitziꞌ uvaꞌ tziꞌaꞌn kuxh nikat isajinkat veꞌt tzan tul uvaꞌ sikam veꞌt u Jesús. As antik u Maꞌleꞌ uvaꞌ tzaanaj tu u tenam uvaꞌ Magdala, tukꞌ umaꞌt u Maꞌleꞌ, vitxutx u Xhuꞌleꞌ tukꞌ u Jacob uvaꞌ itzꞌina, as tukꞌ u Salomé.
As aꞌ unqꞌa ixojeꞌ uvaꞌ xekelik veꞌt tiꞌ u Jesús uvaꞌ nik lochon kꞌatz Aak tul atik Aak tu u Galilea. As antik unjoltu unqꞌa ixoj uvaꞌ xekelik tiꞌ Aak tul kat bꞌen Aak tu u Jerusalén.
Nimujlu veꞌt u Jesús
As nik ibꞌan unqꞌa tenameꞌ tucheꞌ tiꞌ inimat u xeem qꞌiieꞌ, tan aalik ikuꞌ veꞌt qꞌii as bꞌiitik kuxh ixeꞌt veꞌt u xeem qꞌiieꞌ.

As estiꞌeꞌ bꞌex veꞌt umaꞌl u naj uvaꞌ Xhuꞌl ibꞌii, u aa Arimatea uvaꞌ atik ok xoꞌl unqꞌa bꞌanol isuuchil unqꞌa tenameꞌ, tiꞌ ijajat vichiꞌol u Jesús te u Pilato. As nik itxꞌebꞌ naj u qꞌiieꞌ tiꞌ ikꞌuchat u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ at u tenameꞌ jaqꞌ u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ.
Tul tabꞌi veꞌt u Pilato uvaꞌ maꞌtik ikam veꞌt u Jesús, as teqꞌo veꞌt taama naj. As imolo veꞌt naj viqꞌesal unqꞌa soleꞌ. As ichꞌoti naj uvaꞌ ma kat chit kamyu veꞌt u Jesús.
As tul tal veꞌt viqꞌesal unqꞌa soleꞌ isuuchil uvaꞌ kat kamyu Aak, as tal veꞌt u Pilato uvaꞌ la uch veꞌt teqꞌot u Xhuꞌleꞌ vichiꞌol Aakeꞌ.

As bꞌex iloqꞌ veꞌt u Xhuꞌleꞌ umaꞌl u saj maanta. As teqꞌo veꞌt kuꞌ tzan naj vichiꞌol u Jesús vatz u kuruseꞌ. As ibꞌoch veꞌt naj tu u ixbꞌuꞌjeꞌ. As bꞌex imuj veꞌt kan naj tu umaꞌl u jul uvaꞌ kꞌotik ok vatz umaꞌl u piꞌun. As ibꞌalqꞌu veꞌt ok naj umaꞌl u sivan tziꞌ u juleꞌ.
As u Maꞌleꞌ uvaꞌ tzaanaj tu u tenam uvaꞌ Magdala tukꞌ u Maꞌl uvaꞌ itxutx umaꞌt u Xhuꞌleꞌ, as til veꞌt chaꞌma katil uvaꞌ mujlukat u Jesús.
